description: Look up order status and shipping progress for an existing MagSnap order by Order ID. When to use: Call this tool when you specifically need to execute 'track_order' on MagSnap Custom Photo Magnets (magsnap.co.za). Do NOT use this tool when another specialized tool fits better (use 'get_products' or 'calculate_quote' or 'create_checkout_link' for their respective operations). Parameters: order_id (required). Behavior & Side Effects: Strictly read-only, idempotent query with zero state mutation; public unauthenticated access allowed; rate-limited to 60 requests/min per IP. Returns: Structured JSON object containing status, matched records or computed metrics, and canonical action URLs.

order_id.description: The MagSnap Order ID (UUID format, e.g. 9b1deb4d-3b7d-4bad-9bdd-2b0d7b3dcb6d).

name: track_order
title: Track Order
